column3: “Quarry” renders the hollow of a pit.
“Like gnats” gives a concrete comparison for “likewise.”
“Will overtake them” makes gladness and joy the subject rather than what the redeemed attain.
“Why should you” replaces “who are you that”; “withers like grass” expands being made grass.
“To the dregs” expands draining the cup.
“Who can comfort you?” replaces the speaker’s question about whom he can use to comfort.
